mapper.select: SELECT sf.id, sf.user_id, sf.original_name, sf.object_key, sf.bucket_name, sf.content_type, sf.file_size, sf.content_hash, sf.storage_type, sf.created_at, sf.deleted, sf.deleted_at FROM sys_file sf WHERE sf.deleted = 1 AND sf.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND sf.deleted_at <= #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_file other WHERE other.object_key = sf.object_key AND (other.deleted = 0 OR other.deleted_at IS NULL OR other.deleted_at > #{cutoff}) ) ORDER BY sf.deleted_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.file_id FROM recycle_bin r JOIN document d ON d.id = r.resource_id WHERE r.resource_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND r.expire_at > NOW() AND d.file_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT re.file_id FROM recycle_bin r JOIN resume re ON re.id = r.resource_id WHERE r.resource_type = 'RESUME' AND r.expire_at > NOW() AND re.file_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT d.file_id FROM recycle_bin r JOIN document d ON d.knowledge_base_id = r.resource_id WHERE r.resource_type = 'KNOWLEDGE_BASE' AND r.expire_at > NOW() AND d.file_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
